notes: Market value of processed agrifood products, 2004–2013, current Brunei dollars. 2003 dropped (crop-based value not available). Totals recomputed; the published change column was not used. 'new_category_bnd' is 'Makanan Segera' (fast or instant food), first counted in 2013 (0 in 2010–2012 in the category table, which starts in 2010); 'comparable_bnd' leaves it out.
